start_here: Say to your AI: "Measure my takes take-kokoro.wav and take-qwen3.wav against my narration line in line.json: pauses, pace, pitch, word errors and how much each sounds like the reference."

lists.label: Settings
lists.holds: One row per tool and scope (a person, a film, a piece or the whole account): the settings that tool reads when it runs, as JSON.

instructions: 1. Have line.json (script, vowel_check.word, voice_reference, hear_prompt) and the takes as WAV files.

2. Say the line in start_here. Your AI reads the row with tools:list {tool: "tool:measure-narration-takes"}, installs numpy, soundfile, praat-parselmouth, mlx-whisper (and torch, pyannote.audio, transformers, librosa for the voice and accent) if missing, and runs the command in given. If you keep a list:settings row for this folder (record:setting:compare-voice-and-music-models~film~<film>) your AI reads it with tool:read-a-tool-setting, saves it to a file and adds --settings-record that file --film <film>; its values go over the defaults.
3. Read the last line: {"result": {"takes": [one row per take]}}; each row also printed on its own line.
4. Show the takes side by side and say which numbers fall outside the person's ranges; naturalness is their ear's call.

worked_examples.title: A take with one 0.6 s pause between its first two words
worked_examples.ask: Measure these takes of my narration line.
worked_examples.given: From tools/compare-voice-and-music-models/test/test_voice_ab.py (Measure.test_pauses_of_120_ms_or_more_with_the_words_on_each_side and test_the_measures_of_a_take_from_saved_word_times). A made-up take.wav: 0.2 s quiet, tone 0.8 s, pause 0.6 s, tone 1.0 s, pause 0.1 s, tone 0.5 s, 0.3 s quiet; whisper's words are Close. (0.2-1.0 s), The, kettle, boils. (to 3.2 s). line.json = {"script":"Close. The kettle boils.","vowel_check":{"word":"close"}}. Run: python3 -I tools/compare-voice-and-music-models/do-work/measure_takes.py line.json take.wav --no-voice-models
worked_examples.hands_back: {"result":{"takes":[{"take":"take.wav","seconds":<length>,"speech_seconds":3.0,"words_per_s":1.33,"articulation_wps":<4 / (3.0 - 0.6)>,"longest_pause_s":0.6,"pauses":[{"after":"Close.","before":"The","s":0.6}],"f0_p5":...,"f0_p95":...,"span_st":...,"vowel_onset_f2":...,"vowel_ms":...,"word_errors":0,"script_words":4,"heard":"Close. The kettle boils."}]}}: the 0.1 s gap is under the 120 ms line and is not a pause, same_voice and the accent are left out by --no-voice-models, and the word times are saved to work/take.words.json.

pour.how: Name the list you already keep for the same job and read it with records:read (its fields and row type). Run tool:pour-example-rows-into-my-list with that list as into and this kit list as kit_list: it matches each kit field to one of yours (your map, the same id, the same label, or a name in alike), pours nothing under 80% and names the fields with no home, and otherwise answers the one records:write that adds the example rows beside your own.
